name: Royal Realms of Romance
source:
Announcing Royal Realms of Romance—Rule the hearts of vampires, werewolves, and dragons!

In the captivating world of Arcanoria, you, a humble human, are thrust into peril after being falsely accused of a heinous crime. Facing a death sentence, you're saved by the vampire, werewolf, and dragon Kings, who reveal that you hold the key to an ancient prophecy. United by a common purpose, you must navigate treacherous politics, uncover conspiracies, and confront sinister forces to reshape the destiny of their supernatural realms.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.threekings]Google Play[/url]]
